# Numerical and Categorical Data
```{r}
df_day <- read_csv("bike+sharing+dataset/day.csv")[, -1]


cat_col <- c(
  "season", "holiday", "workingday", "weathersit",
  "yr", "mnth", "weekday"
)
num_col <- c(
  "temp", "atemp", "hum", "windspeed"
) # No casual and registered


df_pre <- train_test_split(df_day)
Training <- df_pre$train
Testing <- df_pre$test
```


# Data cleaning
## NA values
From the description of the data set, we know that there are no any NA values.


## *dteday*, *casual*, *registered* for  linear model
Observation:
 - Introducing *dteday* 
 - From the description of the data set, *casual*, *registered* are two parts of *cnt* with correlation close to 1.
 - *mnth* and *season* have a high VIF
 
Insight:
 - Delete the *dteday* or use shrinkage model
 - Delete the two *casual* and *registered*

```{r}
# Outcome
Training <- Training %>% select(-c(
  dteday, casual, registered
))


correlation(Training) %>%
  summary() %>%
  plot() +
  theme_ev()
```


## Correlation
Observation:
 - *season* and *mnth* show a correlation of 0.83.
 - The correlation of the two *temp* and *atemp* is equal to 1.
 
Insight:
 - Feature engineering(heat): A day with high *atemp* and *hum* 
 
```{r}
correlation(df_day, select = c("season", "mnth"))
correlation(Training, select = c("temp", "atemp"))


# Outcome
Training <- Training %>%
  mutate(
    heat = ifelse(atemp * 50 > 27 & hum * 100 > 60, 1, 0), # It will contain a high correlation if use interaction
    heat_inte = atemp * hum
  ) %>%
  select(-c(atemp)) %>%
  mutate(heat = as.factor(heat))


# Training <- Training %>%
#   select(-c(atemp))
```



## Multicollinearity
Observation:
 - *season* and *mnth* show strong VIF (>10)
 
Insight:
 - deleted the *mnth* to reduced multicollinearity and keep *season* since it contain information relating to the *temp*
 
```{r}
lm(cnt ~ ., Training) %>%
  check_collinearity() %>%
  plot() + theme_ev()


correlation(Training) %>%
  summary() %>%
  plot() +
  theme_ev()


# Outcome
Training <- Training %>%
  select(-c(mnth))

lm(cnt ~ ., Training) %>%
  check_collinearity() %>%
  plot() + theme_ev()


correlation(Training) %>%
  summary() %>%
  plot() +
  theme_ev()
```


## Small things
Observation:
 - Since the *workingday* can be directly derive from *holiday* and *weekday*, it contains no additional information.
 
Insight:
 - Delete the *workingday*
 
```{r}
# Outcome
Training <- Training %>%
  select(-c(workingday))


lm(cnt ~ ., Training) %>%
  check_collinearity() %>%
  plot() + theme_ev()


correlation(Training) %>%
  summary() %>%
  plot() +
  theme_ev()
```


## *dteday* and *cnt*
Observation:
 - Significant different between these two years
 
Insight:
 - 
 
```{r}
df_day %>% 
  ggplot(aes(y = cnt, x = dteday)) + 
  geom_line()

Training %>% 
  ggplot(aes(y = temp, x = season)) +
  geom_point()
```



# Linear Model
## Baseline
Observation:
 - 
 
Insight:
 - 
 
```{r}
# Outcome
lm_baseline_model <- lm(cnt ~ ., Training)

lm_baseline_model %>% check_model()
lm_baseline_model %>% model_performance()


```


## Subset selection
Observation:
 - 
 
Insight:
 -  

```{r}
lm_stepwise_model <- lm_baseline_model %>%
  select_parameters() # stepwise base on AIC

lm_stepwise_model %>% check_model()
lm_stepwise_model %>% model_performance()
```


## Shrinkage model
Observation:
 - 
 
Insight:
 - 

```{r}
Training.Lasso <- Training %>%
  select(-c(cnt)) %>%
  model.matrix(~ . - 1, data = .)
cv_fit <- cv.glmnet(
  x = Training.Lasso,
  y = Training$cnt,
  family = "gaussian",
  alpha = 1, # 1 = LASSO；0 = Ridge
  nfolds = 10,
  standardize = TRUE
)
autoplot(cv_fit)


lm_lasso_model <- glmnet(
  x = Training.Lasso,
  y = Training$cnt,
  family = "gaussian",
  alpha = 1,
  lambda = cv_fit$lambda.1se # lambda
)
```


# Model Comparison
Observation:
 - 
 
Insight:
 - 

```{r}
compare_performance(
  lm_baseline_model, lm_stepwise_model
)


compare_performance(
  lm_baseline_model, lm_stepwise_model
) %>%
  plot() +
  theme_ev()
```


# Time series

```{r}
library(tsibble)  
library(fable)   
library(feasts)
library(tseries)
library(ggfortify)
```
```{r}
Training %>%
  as_tsibble(index = dteday) %>%
  autoplot(cnt) +
  geom_line(color = "steelblue", linewidth = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "The original Y",
    subtitle = "Not stationarity",
  ) +
  theme_ev()

Training %>%
  as_tsibble(index = dteday) %>%
  ACF(cnt) %>%
  autoplot() +
  labs(
    title = "The ACF of original Y"
  ) +
  theme_ev()

Training$cnt %>% adf.test()
```

```{r}
Training %>%
  as_tsibble(index = dteday) %>%
  mutate(
    cnt_diff = difference(cnt)
  ) %>%
  autoplot(cnt_diff) +
  labs(title = "1 lag Differencing") + # To remove the seasonality
  theme_ev()


Training %>%
  as_tsibble(index = dteday) %>%
  mutate(
    cnt_diff = difference(cnt)
  ) %>%
  .$cnt_diff %>%
  na.omit() %>%
  adf.test()


Training %>%
  as_tsibble(index = dteday) %>%
  mutate(
    cnt_diff = difference(cnt)
  ) %>%
  ACF(cnt_diff) %>%
  autoplot() +
  labs(
    title = "The ACF of 1 lag Y"
  ) +
  theme_ev()


Training %>%
  as_tsibble(index = dteday) %>%
  ACF(cnt, type = "partial") %>%
  autoplot() +
  labs(
    title = "The PACF of 1 lag Y"
  ) +
  theme_ev()
```


```{r}
Training %>%
  as_tsibble(index = dteday) %>%
  gg_season(cnt, period = "year") +
  labs(title = "每year季节性折线图", y = "使用量")


Training %>%
  as_tsibble(index = dteday) %>%
  gg_season(cnt, period = "month") +
  labs(title = "每月季节性折线图", y = "使用量")


Training %>%
  as_tsibble(index = dteday) %>%
  gg_season(cnt, period = "week") +
  labs(title = "每周季节性折线图", y = "使用量")
    

Training %>%
  as_tsibble(index = dteday) %>%
  index_by(week = ~ yearweek(.)) %>% # 按周聚合
  summarise(avg_cnt = mean(cnt)) %>%
  autoplot(avg_cnt) +
  labs(title = "每周平均使用量趋势", y = "平均使用量")
```

```{r}
Training %>%
  as_tsibble(index = dteday) %>%
  # fill_gaps(cnt = 0) %>%
  model(classical_decomposition(cnt)) %>%
  components() %>%
  autoplot() +
  labs(
    title = "Decoposition"
  )

Training %>%
  as_tsibble(index = dteday) %>%
  ACF(cnt) %>%
  autoplot()


Training %>%
  as_tsibble(index = dteday) %>%
  ACF(cnt, type = "partial") %>%
  autoplot()
```

```{r}
Training %>%
  as_tsibble(index = dteday) %>%
  autoplot(difference(cnt))

Training %>%
  as_tsibble(index = dteday) %>%
  model(ARIMA(cnt))
```
